utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Case number IT-95-16-T, the Prosecutor versus Zoran Kupreskic, Mirjan Kupreskic, Vlatko Kupreskic, Drago Josipovic, Dragan Papic, Vladimir Santic, also known as "Vlado."

utterances.speaker: MR. TERRIER
utterances.text: Good morning, Witness. A moment ago, we were talking about the soldiers who came into your home and threw in grenades. You talked, in particular, about an insignia that he was wearing on his uniform. I'm now going to request that the usher come forward and show you two photographs of insignia and tell us, please, whether you recognise this insignia.

utterances.speaker: MR. TERRIER
utterances.text: Please look at this insignia, which has the initials "HVO." Now, look at the second insignia which bears the letters "HV." Do you recognise one or the other of these two insignia as the one worn by the soldier on the 16th of April?

utterances.speaker: MR. TERRIER
utterances.text: That is the insignia you recognised as having been worn by that soldier. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. TERRIER
utterances.text: Mr. President, I would request that we go to closed session because I would like to show a photograph of the house of the witness to this Tribunal.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE CASSESE
utterances.text: Yes. We will go into closed session, and I see that Mr. Pavkovic would like to raise an issue.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE CASSESE
utterances.text: Whereupon proceedings adjourned at 4.09 p.m., to be reconvened on Wednesday, the 2nd day of September, 1998, at 9.30 a.m.
